purpose: Test whether family-resolved Qwen representation bundles form lineage-connected, noise-valid context-by-checkpoint loops and whether their prereveal holonomy predicts path-dependent causal effects of signed activation edits beyond local lineage and Jacobian visibility.
claim_boundary: This protocol can establish or falsify an empirical organization and causal-prediction claim on the frozen models, prompts, sites, and interventions. It cannot prove semantic identity, capability preservation, weight-edit efficacy, compactification, recursive improvement, or RSI. A geometry collapse is a resolved negative boundary, not permission to change axes, ranks, floors, or prompts after reveal.

development_model.role: architecture-and-cost pilot plus provisional real-model evidence
development_model.state_provenance_limit: The adapters came from an eight-row engineering smoke run and cannot support a VPD-versus-shuffled scientific claim. They provide a real checkpoint axis only.
development_model.activation_object: first tensor in residual-block output at the final non-padding prompt token

loader.reason: Transformers 5.3 sizes its optional speed-only warm-up from the unquantized multimodal parameter graph and OOMs before loading this 4-bit checkpoint on a 4 GB GPU. Disabling the warm-up changes allocation scheduling, not weights or forward mathematics.

confirmatory_model.role: frozen confirmatory model after development code and thresholds are sealed
confirmatory_model.activation_object: first tensor in residual-block output at the final non-padding prompt token
confirmatory_model.checkpoint_rule: Use base plus at least two newly provenance-stamped construction-only checkpoints. Existing outcome-contaminated checkpoints may be reported as engineering evidence but cannot enter confirmatory gates.

precision_rule: Use one frozen runtime precision within each causal loop. Precision is a stress axis reported separately and may not substitute for a checkpoint edge. Cross-precision failure cannot be repaired by pooling.

prompt_splits.separation_rule: The causal manifest must have zero byte-identical prompts with the geometry manifest. Outer prompt bytes, answers, activations, and scores remain unread until the geometry-derived candidate table is hashed.

stage_1_geometry.primary_object: cross-fitted top-r between-class-scatter eigenspaces of frozen subcondition means
stage_1_geometry.graph_axis: context_shard x model_state within one site, family, rank, and runtime precision
stage_1_geometry.checkpoint_edges: base-to-each-adapter or adjacent registered checkpoints at fixed context shard
stage_1_geometry.context_edges: adjacent context shards at fixed model state
stage_1_geometry.negative_control: matched random labels with the real activation spectrum; required strict 95% lower-confidence retention margin above permutation null of 0.02
stage_1_geometry.loop_admission: all edges are in one G_tau component; beta_1 = |E_tau|-|V|+c(G_tau) is positive; det and angle receipt survives prompt-resample validation
stage_1_geometry.noise_valid_holonomy: held-out maximum canonical angle exceeds the matched flat-estimation-noise 95th percentile and construction/validation determinant plus angle spectrum agree
stage_1_geometry.family_grouping_estimand: held-out within-family partial-transport distance is smaller than equal-rank cross-family distance under physical-site clustered bootstrap

stop_states.family_grouping_not_established: report geometry without a behavior-family organization claim

stage_2_prereveal_candidate_table.entry_condition: At least one negative-control-passing graph has beta_1>0 and at least one noise-valid orientation-preserving loop. Orientation reversals remain denial controls and do not enter angle regression.
stage_2_prereveal_candidate_table.loop_sampling: Within each eligible model, site, family, and state-pair stratum, sample loops across frozen maximum-angle quartiles. Cap development at 48 loops and confirmation at 64 loops using seeded reservoir sampling; do not select only the largest angles.
stage_2_prereveal_candidate_table.path_pair: For every elementary rectangle, compare context-then-checkpoint against checkpoint-then-context transport from the same root fiber to the same target fiber.
stage_2_prereveal_candidate_table.outer_prompt_allocation: After the candidate table hash is sealed, deterministically assign six causal_outer prompts from the target family and shard, balanced over subconditions where possible.
sealed_before_outer_read: loop universe and geometry receipt hashes

stage_2_intervention.kind: paired signed residual-stream activation additions at the registered target block and final prompt token
stage_2_intervention.same_target_rule: Both path-specific coordinates are converted through the same target ambient basis and applied to the identical target model, prompt, token, layer, sign, and norm.
stage_2_intervention.primary_outcome: absolute difference between the two edits' changes in teacher-forced expected-answer negative log likelihood relative to the shared unedited baseline
secondary_outcomes: Jensen-Shannon distance between next-token distributions under the two edits
L2 distance between final-residual causal deltas
stage_2_intervention.primary_inference: Nested grouped out-of-fold regression; groups are loop_id and outer prompt subcondition, with leave-one-family-out and leave-one-state-pair-out stress reports.
stage_2_intervention.practical_margin: Holonomy features must reduce grouped held-out SSE by at least 0.10 and the grouped-bootstrap one-sided 95% lower bound must be strictly above zero.
stage_2_intervention.direction_dose_response: Within the same loop and norm, maximally exposed directions must exceed minimally exposed directions in median primary outcome with one-sided grouped-bootstrap lower bound above zero.
stage_2_intervention.flat_control: Loops below the registered noise floor cannot be used as positive evidence and are evaluated only as a negative-control stratum.
stage_2_intervention.authorization_evaluation: A conservative risk gate is evaluated for coverage and false-safe rate. No real-model deterministic safety guarantee is claimed from the synthetic Lipschitz calibration.

stage_2_decisions.causal_holonomy_supported: All instrument gates pass, the incremental-prediction practical margin passes, and the exposed-versus-minimal direction dose response passes on causal_outer.
stage_2_decisions.geometry_without_causal_value: Natural geometry passes but either incremental prediction or direction dose response fails.
stage_2_decisions.holonomy_unavailable: No eligible loop universe exists at the frozen floors and ranks.
stage_2_decisions.invalid_instrument: Negative control, gauge replay, receipt completeness, candidate-table chronology, or outer split separation fails.
stage_2_decisions.engineering_only: Development adapter provenance or hard-cap provenance is insufficient for confirmatory claims.

matched_controls: covariance/Gram object reported but prohibited from gates
minimally exposed direction inside each eligible loop
seeded Haar direction at matched norm
node-wise gauge reframing preserving ambient edits and decisions
permuted holonomy features within loop/state/family groups

resource_contract.checkpoint_unit: one state x site x context shard x split activation capture, and one causal candidate batch during outer evaluation

vpd_handoff.analysis: Compare VPD-selected versus matched-random weight edits within preregistered identity and holonomy-risk strata; do not optimize edit directions on causal_outer.
vpd_handoff.failure_interpretation: If identity-clean VPD edits still do not beat matched random, strengthen the VPD null rather than revising the atlas.
